scope: Finite core rules and source-level rendering audit; not a Lean or browser certification

checks.name: Valid and rejected actions do not mutate the input state
All relevant dependencies are checked at the start of a beat
Rescuing all three nearby people does not remove device demand
Supply depends only on the selected network configuration
A widened-road platform win reports its actual route and expense
Two available return routes cannot rescue the same person twice
Flow witnesses have correct endpoints, commodity totals and edge loads
The affine picture uses the declared Gaussian-prime anchor coordinates
Direct return samples remain on the completed relay polyline
Reachable finite states preserve rescue uniqueness, budgets and exact undo
